concepts.title: 放射性与几何增长
concepts.summary: 原开篇以夜光表盘的镭与氚说明指数衰减；细菌与投资说明几何增长。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 对相同间隔比较数量之比，建立指数模型；本章学习特征、变换及解指数方程。

en.title: Radioactivity and geometric growth
en.summary: The opening uses radium and tritium watch dials to introduce exponential decay; bacteria and investments illustrate geometric growth.

method.title: Method
method.body: Compare ratios over equal intervals to build exponential models; this chapter studies characteristics, transformations, and exponential equations.

concepts.title: 本章术语
concepts.summary: 指数函数、指数增长、指数衰减、半衰期、指数方程。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 指数函数变量在指数上；增长因子大于1；衰减因子介于0与1；半衰期是剩余量减半所需时间；指数方程含未知指数。

en.title: Chapter vocabulary
en.summary: Exponential function, exponential growth, exponential decay, half-life, exponential equation.

method.title: Method
method.body: An exponential function has a variable exponent; a growth factor exceeds 1; a decay factor lies between 0 and 1; half-life is time to halve; an exponential equation contains an unknown exponent.

concepts.title: 职业联系：化学
concepts.summary: 化学帮助认识周围世界，并创造新物质与材料。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 化学家合成、发现和表征分子及反应，可研究合成纤维、药物、可持续能源和更环保的制造过程。原职业网站为延伸阅读；开篇无编号准备题。

en.title: Career Link: chemistry
en.summary: Chemistry helps explain the world and create new substances and materials.

method.title: Method
method.body: Chemists synthesize, discover, and characterize molecules and reactions; applications include synthetic fibres, pharmaceuticals, sustainable energy, and greener manufacturing. The career website is enrichment; the opening has no numbered preparation questions.

concepts.title: 历史旁注
concepts.summary: 原书提及镭曾添加于日用品，后来发现严重健康影响而禁止这些用途。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 把该段作为理解教材历史背景的叙述；数学任务是建立增长与衰减模型。

en.title: Historical sidebar
en.summary: The textbook notes radium was once added to consumer products before serious adverse health effects led to prohibitions.

method.title: Method
method.body: Read this as the textbook’s historical context; the mathematical task is to model growth and decay.
